description: Figure 2 is a grouped bar chart that compares the accuracy of different models on two tasks: paraphrase sentiment and Semantic Textual Similarity (STS). The horizontal axis displays five distinct model configurations: "Single-task Baseline", "Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout", "Unsupervised_SimCSE", "Supervised_SimCSE", and "2-Tier_SimCSE". The vertical axis represents the "Accuracy / Correlation" score, ranging from 0 to 0.8. For each model, two bars are shown, representing the results on the two tasks. The legend indicates that the light orange bars correspond to "Sentiment Acc" (accuracy on the paraphrase sentiment task) and the light blue bars represent "STS Corr" (correlation on the STS task). The chart shows that the "2-Tier_SimCSE" model achieves the highest accuracy on both tasks, with a sentiment accuracy of approximately 0.78 and an STS correlation of about 0.76. The "Supervised_SimCSE" model follows closely, with a sentiment accuracy of around 0.75 and an STS correlation of about 0.74. The "Unsupervised_SimCSE" model has a sentiment accuracy of approximately 0.55 and an STS correlation of about 0.72. The "Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout" model has a sentiment accuracy of about 0.57 and an STS correlation of around 0.74. The "Single-task Baseline" model has the lowest performance, with a sentiment accuracy of approximately 0.55 and an STS correlation of about 0.76.
